d:
Mithilesh Tiwari On Tejashwi Yadav : bihar men aanand mohan aur anant sinh se jure mamlon par tejasvi yadav ke bayan ko lekar siyasi bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. bijepi neta mithilesh tivari ne tejasvi yadav par tikha palatvar kiya hai.
Mithilesh tivari ne tejasvi ki parhaee par tanj kaste hue kaha ki agar unhonne lo ki parhaee ki hoti to kort men jakar in logon ke paksh men achchhi tarah bahas kar sakte the. unhonne kaha, "tejasvi ji ki parhaee hi maitrik tak puri nahin huee hai, to kya jakar bahas karenge?"
